title: Hypoxia imaging as a radiomics signature in tumors using novelF-Eu-based contrast agents for magnetic resonance imaging.
snippet: Accurately identifying and characterizing tumor hypoxia is critical for understanding disease biology and treatment response, yet current in vivo methods provide limited direct, spatially resolved information.
